observed_original_abi.calling_convention: __thiscall (derived, confidence INFERRED, verdict ABI_INFERRED): the receiver is the ECX hidden argument. V1-VFT: 0x00b1e4d0 is a slot of a vptr-backed vftable, so it is a non-static virtual member function; the callee pops nothing (bare RET) and no stack word is read as an argument (the body names no memory operand), so the receiver cannot arrive on the stack; the only register that carries a receiver in this derivation is ECX (EDX is never read either), so the convention is __thiscall with caller cleanup and 0 ordinary stack arguments
observed_original_abi.receiver: ECX, never read in any form by the body (the derived receiver record: present=false, provenance=vftable_slot, register=ECX); the reconstruction's parameter is unnamed because the machine gives it no use
observed_original_abi.return_type_rationale: THE MACHINE FIXES A WIDTH, NOT A TYPE. The terminal write is XOR AL,AL (30 c0): one byte, the low byte of EAX, value zero. The derived return record states return.register=EAX, return.type=null - the C type is deliberately unclaimed by the machine. The reconstruction declares bool, which is exactly one byte wide and is the spelling of AL:=0 for a predicate; the return-semantics evidence is WIDTH_1_IN_EAX and a one-byte declaration agrees with it. The upper 24 bits of EAX are indeterminate at the RET and are not read anywhere in this package. A wider declaration (int, int32_t) would contradict the listing's one-byte write.
observed_original_abi.locals: none; the body allocates no frame, saves no register and builds no record
observed_original_abi.outgoing_calls: none; the body holds no CALL, no JMP and no indirect transfer

observed_mechanics: 0x00b1e4d0 30 c0 - XOR AL,AL: the single write of the body, one byte wide (AL only), value zero; no other register, flag input or memory operand is touched.
0x00b1e4d2 c3 - RET: a bare return with no immediate, so the callee pops nothing and the caller owns the (zero-byte) cleanup.
The body is 3 bytes and contains no branch, no call, no flag test, no register save and no loop: it is the shared 'return false' default, one XOR and one RET.
No instruction reads ECX or any memory operand, so the receiver is carried but never used and no displacement, extent or member is claimed for it.

The compilation of the staged reconstruction is NOT claimed byte-identical to the target: clang -m32 -O0 spells 'return false' as push ebp / push eax / xor eax,eax / and $0x1,al / ... / ret, which is semantically the same one-byte zero return and the same ESP-neutral caller-cleaned shape, but not the same bytes. The machine facts (AL:=0, bare RET, ECX unread) are the ones modelled and tested.
